title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
summary: Database client connection pool has reached its max capacity, causing queries to queue and fail with timeout exceptions.
mitigation_steps: 1. Inspect active connection count in pg_stat_activity / processlist.
3. Temporarily increase pool overflow limit or scale database connection pooler (PgBouncer).

title: Redis Memory Exhaustion / OOM Eviction
summary: Redis cache has exceeded maxmemory configuration and is unable to allocate new keys without evicting volatile entries.
mitigation_steps: 1. Check Redis memory usage with INFO MEMORY.
2. Flush non-critical cache partitions or expired sessions.
3. Increase maxmemory configuration or scale Redis cluster node.

title: Payment Service API Timeout / Circuit Breaker
summary: Payment processing downstream gateway is experiencing elevated latency or HTTP 504 gateway timeouts.
mitigation_steps: 1. Check third-party payment gateway status page for upstream outages.
2. Enable circuit-breaker fallback to queue asynchronous retry jobs.
3. Restart payment-processor service to reset stale HTTP connection pools.

title: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff
summary: Container is repeatedly crashing during startup due to uncaught exception, missing config, or OOMKilled signal.
mitigation_steps: 1. Inspect last termination logs: kubectl logs <pod> --previous.
2. Check if latest deployment commit introduced breaking environment variables.
3. Rollback deployment to previous stable release SHA.

title: High CPU Saturation on Background Workers
summary: Background task queue is processing high-complexity jobs resulting in sustained >95% CPU utilization.
mitigation_steps: 1. Inspect queue backlog and identify long-running heavy tasks.
2. Scale up replica count for worker pool.
3. Throttle batch ingestion rates if necessary.
